$comment: D7 activity_input motion control: strict exact allowlist {steer,tuck,brake,jumpHeld}, finite steer in [-1,1]. The server derives charge/release edges from accepted held states; no client dt/time/position/score fields exist. Prioritized latest control wins per rider per tick.
name: input-ride
invariants: seq is monotonic per lease, starting at 1 after rotation
unknown fields on controls are rejected invalid_request (strict allowlist)
non-finite or out-of-range steer is rejected invalid_request
accepted seq proves receipt only; lastAcceptedSeqs is diagnostic and never acknowledges simulation (appliedSeq does)
inputs before scheduled start update held-state only, no motion, no charged-jump advantage
input starvation under an open connection uses neutral braking at the watchdog, known disconnect freezes
